anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing regressed: After keeps f2 (no watch, no re-dispatch of the unchanged P1 between the helper result and the report) and gains f1 and f3. Before persisted the no-progress record but still rendered `Verdict: fixable - 1 blocker` with ordinary `wait`/`fix` rows and `fix` recommended, so it never surfaced the helper result as a needs obstacle; After evaluates the Early Exit at Re-render entry, names the verdict `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff`, and renders the obstacle template with numeric deliver/assess, stop recommended last, and no fix/wait rows. The deliver row's clause 'retries the repair once src/guard.ts outside the diff is in reach' plus narration step 7 ('cannot be re-dispatched unchanged') is what carries the 'extension alone cannot clear it' requirement — keep that explicit phrasing. One wording nit to tighten without changing any fact: the deliver row advertises 'add 6 to each cap' while usage is only 1/6 and 0/6, which reads as an unselected cap extension on a non-exhausted budget; consider rendering the cumulative-extension text only when a cap is actually reached, so the obstacle row doesn't imply the extension is the remedy for the unmet prerequisite.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly: section 2 turns the retained `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` result into an explicit `stuck - needs ...` exit before any watch, repair, round charge, cap extension or deadline mint (f1), the refresh and comment reads in section 3 dispatch nothing and the obstacle template follows directly (f2), and the menu has numeric deliver/assess with stop recommended last, evidence only in a hint, and no fix/wait rows (f3). Before failed all three because it kept the old per-action model: it treated the open result as merely withholding redispatch, rendered `fixable - 1 blocker` with ordinary `wait`/`fix` rows (fix recommended) and never produced an obstacle report. One wording tightening for After: the deliver row says 'add 6 to each cap' alongside 'retry repair after the required source change becomes available'; stating outright that the extension does not itself clear the needs prerequisite (e.g. 'extension alone does not satisfy the missing src/guard.ts change') would make the last clause of f3 explicit rather than inferred, and the Evidence line plus the identical evidence hint could be collapsed so the hint remains the single evidence surface.
